newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes down in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes down in thin trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed 0.99 percent lower at 454.84 from 459.41 on Tuesday, bourse sources said. Total volume was a thin 375,780 dinars against one million dinars over the previous session.
Detergents firm SPCD fell 2.74 dinars to 28.96 dinars with only 40 shares changing hands.
Arab Tunisian Bank was down 1.64 dinar to 26.22.
Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF eased 0.43 dinar to 14.59 dinars.
Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie edged lower 0.38 dinar to 28.62.
Household firm Ateliers Mecaniques du Sahel declined 0.3 dinar to 9.5 dinars.
BTEI bank was down 0.26 dinar to 21.74 dinars. ($1=1.0952 dinar)
